gaps.lighting: The sun reads as a flat warm side light, not a low back-light. Sunlit tower faces clip to near-white (bridge_skyline p95 luma 201) instead of #E9B073 amber. Nothing has a rim (player, peds, palms, bridge arches). Hero key elevation is 11.9 deg against the bible's 9. The player is a dark silhouette at luma 32.5, below the floor of 40 (hero).
gaps.time_of_day: At night the player is a black shape (luma 19.6, floor 40) lit only by the magenta terminal glow. The sky has ~2400 large stars, which is impossible over a lit CBD. The ferry canopy blooms into a white-pink blob. Noon water goes swimming-pool cyan (hero_noon). The default start hour 17.25 puts the sun at 21 deg, which is not golden hour.
gaps.palette: Three colours from the avoid list are on screen: cyan water at noon (hero_noon), pale beige/pink pavers that read as 'white paving' (critic pose-2/pose-4/yaw-2 crops), and lime/chartreuse leaves (pose-1 crop, street_sgt, kings_park). The CBD reads white-cream (bridge_skyline, river_cbd), while the real skyline is deep blue glass (eq2, kpview).
gaps.materials: Curtain walls are a perfectly regular grid with bright mullion and transom lines, and ~10% of panels show TV-static speckle (hero_back, hero_night, phone_hud). The palm trunk is a smooth untextured tan tube (mends). Paver albedo is about 3x the bible's charcoal granite. Water reflections break into large zig-zags (street_sgt, hero).
gaps.vegetation: Trees are evenly spaced chartreuse 'lollipop' crowns on pale stems over bright lawn (kings_park), where the reference is a closed dark-olive eucalypt canopy (kpview). Street trees are sparse lime cards (street_sgt). Palms have bald trunks (mends).
gaps.architecture: OSM extrusions read as boxes with a texture grid. There are no crowns (the BHP/Brookfield exoskeleton crown, the Central Park top and other skyline signatures in eq2 are missing), no podium shopfront glazing, and little rooftop plant visible at distance (bridge_skyline, aerial).
gaps.characters: Peds stand on a promenade edge that doesn't read, so they look like they float against the podium facade (hero, hero_noon). There is no rim or warm terminator on skin and clothes. The mends player has believable adult proportions. The swimming hero placement is excluded as a harness error.
gaps.composition: Player x 0.50 against the 0.40 +/- 0.08 target. Horizon ~0.53 against 0.45. Empty sky ~38% against the 35% max (hero, estimated by eye). The brightest value is the cloud or sky, not the focal point. The inlet-to-bridge leading line exists but is weak, because the EQ Bridge reads as a single thin hoop.
gaps.atmosphere: The sky gradient and clouds are good (river_cbd, critic pose-1), but mid-distance is too clean: there's no humid veil and no split between warm haze toward the sun and blue haze in shadow (bridge_skyline). The aerial shows a hard grey ring at the horizon (map edge or far-field band).
gaps.ui: The HUD is legible and on-tribute. The pink/yellow bars are very thin at 0.75 scale (~3.7 px tall), and the minimap is large for a phone.
gaps.mobile: Four 66-92 px buttons plus a 190x120 minimap cover ~30% of an 844x390 screen. The low tier has no planar reflection, so the water is grey streaks (phone_hud). 2.34M tris / 428 calls is too heavy for a phone low tier.
gaps.artefacts: Horizon ring and map edge (aerial). Radial zoom-streak pattern in the water around the camera (hero, phone_hud). Static speckle in glass cells (hero_back, hero_night). Peds and benches floating at promenade height with no visible quay wall below them (hero, hero_noon, hero_back). Night terminal bloom blob (hero_night). Excluded harness errors: street_sgt camera below terrain, swimming player, palm in front of the mends camera.
gaps.real_game: This reads as a competent WebGL tech demo of a real city, not a shipped GTA-style frame. The water, sky and day cycle are the strongest parts. Facades, ground, vegetation and characters are the weakest.

measurements.sun_vs_camera_hero: sun bearing ~252 deg, camera bearing ~205 deg: sun 47 deg camera-right, at the frame edge (matches the bible's intent)

fixes.problem: Perth Water reflections shatter into metre-scale zig-zags, and a radial zoom-streak pattern surrounds the camera. The reference river (eq2, tricia1) is a near-mirror with fine ripples. The planar reflection lookup offsets the world position by seaN.xz * 1.5 m at every distance.
fixes.fix: Cut the reflection offset and ramp it with distance (0.25 m near the camera, 0.9 m at 300 m+). Calm the river wave set so the 'mirror-like water' bible element reads.

fixes.problem: EQ promenade setts read pale beige/pink (avoid list: white paving). Albedos 0.13/0.22/0.34 linear are ~3x the bible's #4A4C50 (0.07 linear), so after golden-hour exposure the paving is the brightest value in the frame.
fixes.fix: Darken the paver set toward charcoal plus mid-grey, deepen the joints and tame the ground macro brightening.

fixes.problem: The CBD reads as white/cream 1990s CAD boxes (bridge_skyline, river_cbd, aerial). Perth's skyline is dominated by deep blue and blue-grey reflective glass (eq2, kpview). White frames from FR.white, OSM 'white' and random picks, plus the low far-field glass fraction for punched/resi styles, push the averages to white.
fixes.fix: Shift frame tones down, raise the far-average glass fraction, and bias random OSM picks to blue/grey glass with alu frames.

fixes.problem: Player luma is 19.6 at night and 32.5 in the golden-hour hero, both below the floor of 40. The bible asks for a #FFC890 rim on characters, and none exists. The moonlight key is too weak to model anything.
fixes.fix: Add a cheap Fresnel rim plus a minimum-ambient term to the character and ped materials (warm by day, moon-blue at night, stronger with uNight). Raise the moon key.

fixes.problem: Leaves are saturated chartreuse lollipops on pale stems, evenly spaced over bright lawn (kings_park, street_sgt, critic pose-1). The base leaf texture rgb(70,110,40), the light tints and translucency 0.35 together produce lime. The reference is a closed dark-olive eucalypt canopy (kpview) and the bible ramp is #4E5E32-#9AA868.
fixes.fix: Desaturate and darken the leaf atlas and tints, cut the back-light translucency, darken the stems, and close the Kings Park canopy with larger, denser clumps (high tier; low keeps tier thinning).

fixes.problem: Golden hour isn't where the bible puts it. The default start of 17.25 gives a 21 deg sun (flat afternoon), and the hero at 18.0 gives 11.9 deg against the 9 deg key. Long raking shadows and hot glints only appear at about 18.2-18.3.
fixes.fix: Move the default start to 18.05. Shoot the hero views at 18.25 (8.9 deg). Optionally halve the clock speed while the sun is between 3 and 15 deg so golden hour lasts more than 2 real minutes.

fixes.problem: About 8-12% of glass cells show high-frequency white 'TV static' by day and purple-white speckle at night (hero_back, hero_night, phone_hud). The likely cause is near-mirror roughness (0.05) sampling a noisy env/sky, plus the star field at night, through the per-panel tilt. The facade's weathering dust term on metal glass may also contribute.
fixes.fix: Raise the minimum glass roughness, halve the oil-canning tilt, zero the facade weather dust, and keep stars and the moon out of the env bake (separate layer).

fixes.problem: Over a lit CBD the night sky shows thousands of big white stars, which looks fake and reads as UI speckle. The ferry terminal canopy and the arch LEDs bloom into a white-magenta blob that is the brightest thing in the frame (hero_night).
fixes.fix: Thin and dim the stars for urban light pollution, and cut the night bloom multiplier and the canopy/LED emissive peaks.

fixes.problem: At noon the river turns swimming-pool cyan/teal (avoid list), and the hero right half goes green-teal. The water scatter colour has G about equal to B, while the bible's #2F5F7A is blue-dominant.
fixes.fix: Shift the scatter toward blue and absorb more red and green.

fixes.problem: Peds and benches at PROMENADE_Y (2.2 m) appear to float against the EQ West podium facade. No quay wall or coping lip reads between them and the water (hero, hero_noon, hero_back), and the benches in hero_back hang in the air.
fixes.fix: Check that the quay-wall strip (ground.js wallPts) covers the EQ West and Landing frontage. Add a dark wet band 0-0.4 m above the water and a 0.55 m pale limestone coping so the edge reads. Snap promenade benches to heightAt() rather than the constant PROMENADE_Y where the ground differs.

fixes.problem: The low tier draws 2.34M tris in 428 calls, too heavy for a mid-range phone. It also has no planar reflection, so the water is grey streaky env (phone_hud), which wastes the signature surface.
fixes.fix: Thin the scatter further and shorten draw distance on low. Spend part of the savings on a quarter-res planar reflection limited to towers and sky.

fixes.problem: The aerial shows a hard grey ring/band around the horizon and a flat untextured terrain edge. The sea grid (far 5200 m) and the mountain far-field layer (radius 5200 m) coincide, and the mountain body colour is darker and greyer than the horizon haze.
fixes.fix: Separate the radii, fog the far layers fully into the horizon colour, and give the scarp a hazy blue-violet body.

fixes.problem: Mid-distance air is too clean. Towers 500-1000 m away keep full contrast (bridge_skyline), so the GTA VI humid veil and warm-toward-sun / blue-in-shadow split are missing. Fog start (40 m) is also nearer than the bible's 60 m.
fixes.fix: Thicken the analytic haze about 1.6x with a bluer extinction, push fog start to the bible's near distance, and push shadow teal slightly.

fixes.problem: Player x is 0.50 against the 0.40 target. The shoulder offset of 0.45 m is applied parallel to the look target, so it only moves the player ~0.05. The horizon at 0.53 and empty sky at ~38% exceed the targets (0.45 / 35%).
fixes.fix: Double the shoulder offset and pitch down slightly. Have the QA harness use the game camera rig rather than its own centred framing.

fixes.problem: None of the skyline's signature tops are present (BHP/Brookfield exoskeleton frame crown, Central Park crown, Rio Tinto/108 St Georges spire massing). There's no street-level shopfront band, so podiums read as offices to the ground (bridge_skyline, street_sgt, eq2).
fixes.fix: Add crown tiers to NAMED_STYLE (Brookfield: open steel frame 2 bays high, 24 m; Central Park: stepped top with 36 m mast). In facade.js, treat vFUv.y < 5.5 m as a shopfront band: 0.9 glass, warm interior emissive 0.3 day / 1.2 night, dark 0.4 m fascia above.

fixes.problem: The Washingtonia trunk is a smooth, untextured tan 9-sided tube (mends). Real palms have ringed fibrous bark and a dense brown petticoat. The crown has only 16 fronds.
fixes.fix: Use a bark surface with 0.12 m leaf-scar rings (normal plus albedo), darken the trunk, raise radial segments, and add fronds plus a dead-frond skirt colour.

trunk material: weathered_wood ring map, tint 0x6a5e50, ring period 0.12 m

fixes.problem: On 844x390 the four right-hand buttons (66-92 px) and the 190x120 minimap take ~30% of the screen. The bars are ~3.7 px tall at 0.75 scale and hard to read over the sky.
fixes.fix: Shrink the buttons and minimap, make the buttons more transparent, and thicken the bars.

fixes.problem: Kings Park lawns read flat saturated green with visible regular mowing stripes, and the paths have hard black edges (kings_park).
fixes.fix: Pull lawn green toward olive, weaken the stripes, and lighten the path asphalt edge.

broken.what: Horizon ring band and flat terrain edge at the map boundary
Radial zoom-streak pattern in the water around the camera (reflection offset 1.5 m and radial grid)
TV-static speckle in random glass cells (day), purple-white speckle (night)
Peds and benches floating at promenade height with no visible quay wall below (may combine with the swimming-camera placement)
Ferry terminal canopy blooms into a magenta-white blob at night
Excluded (known harness errors, already fixed): street_sgt camera under terrain; swimming player in hero*/phone_hud; palm trunk in front of the mends camera
